mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average signals an expansion in economic demand, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of payroll employment growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 6-month moving average signals an expansion in economic supply, leading to increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above its 3-month moving average, combined with a decline in the unemployment rate below 8%, signals a strong demand for housing and labor, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are above their 3-month moving average and the unemployment rate is below 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1%, combined with a rise in the consumer price index above its 6-month moving average, signals an easing monetary cycle with rising inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 1% and the consumer price index is above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is above its 3-month moving average and the unemployment rate is below 7% (t-test p > 0.05).
